meta.title: Rejecting a participant is refused for a caller who is neither purchaser nor auction team
gaps: the plan has the vendor send PATCH /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}/reject_participant, but the supplier app may not call PATCH /event_groups/:id/reject_participant (it is not on agribid_website's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
warnings: error code 101 is not in en-IN.yml (or the backend checkout is missing) — the message cannot be checked

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the event groups reject participant request, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
